exposure: Age of the mother at first delivery
Family history of pelvic organ prolapse
cohort: The study included 348 women visiting Arba Minch, Sawla, and Jinka General Hospitals in Southern Ethiopia, identified as cases with pelvic organ prolapse and controls without it.
finding: Age of the mother at first delivery, carrying heavy objects, place of previous delivery, mode of previous delivery, family history of pelvic organ prolapse, body mass index, and household food insecurity were identified as significant determinants of pelvic organ prolapse.
mod_finding: Mode of previous delivery was significantly associated with pelvic organ prolapse (AOR=3, 95% CI: 1.73-8.44).
